# Synthetic document administration

Extend the supplied working PHP/SQLite web application. Login, shared profile editing and basic bilingual PDF downloads already work. Complete template configuration, image upload/placement, machine-readable reference content and consistent document-feature auditing. Ask the synthetic client for the missing business policies; implementation choices remain yours.

Files: `storage.php` contains existing persistence/authentication data helpers; `router.php` routes HTTP requests; `document.php` renders the existing preview; `features.php` contains unfinished feature hooks and the preview export; `init.php` initializes/reset synthetic data; `web/` is the functional browser UI; `fixtures/` contains independent demo profiles and the public font input range. Preserve established behavior while extending the application. All supplied files are independently authored. There is no client code, original document, seal or external identity.

## Environment and operation

Profile `php-document`, Linux AMD64, PHP 8.3.28, TCPDF 6.8.2 with DejaVu Sans fonts, SQLite, GD, mbstring and bcmath; Python 3.12.3, Chromium/Playwright, pypdf 6.10.0, pypdfium2 5.13.0, Pillow 12.3.0 and zxing-cpp 3.0.0 are preinstalled. TCPDF_ROOT=/opt/sweclar/tcpdf. No Composer install, server download, external account, original file or network access is needed. The image is prepared and its protected preflight completed before agent work starts.

Workdir /workspace. Writable application data lives under DOCUMENT_DATA_DIR (default /workspace/data); the app creates it as the candidate UID. `php init.php --reset` resets only this selected application's database and initializes synthetic accounts/profiles. `php -S 0.0.0.0:8000 router.php` starts the app; visit http://127.0.0.1:8000/. Ctrl-C stops it. Set DOCUMENT_DATA_DIR to a fresh writable directory to isolate a separate attempt. `python /public_tests/test_public.py` owns a separate temporary data directory and an ephemeral loopback server, exercises the app, terminates its server and leaves a manually started app untouched. `php -l router.php` is a basic syntax check; the public tests check all supplied PHP files. Errors go to the server terminal. Resources: 2 CPU, 2 GiB memory/swap ceiling, 256 PIDs, 512 MiB workspace, 1 GiB /tmp; loopback-only execution, unprivileged UID 1000, zero capabilities. Dependencies and evaluator files are protected.

## Existing foundation

The shared workspace has accounts `admin-a`, `admin-b` (admin) and `editor-a` (editor); all demo passwords are `demo-pass`. These are synthetic local credentials. Store password hashes and opaque session tokens server-side. Authentication is established by login and the HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict `document_session` cookie; neither request actor/role fields nor role-like headers grant authority. Logout invalidates the session. Every /api route except login requires an active session. Static UI is readable without login and shows the login form. No app data is embedded into static assets. Request bodies are data, never executable paths or code. Persist profiles and sessions in SQLite; restart preserves completed changes. Database schema is supplied as maintainable starter context, but equivalent schemas are accepted if behavior and actual persistence match.

Profiles are shared synthetic records. Both roles can list, create and update them. Each profile has an `id` matching `[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}` and a `values` object with exactly these six keys: document_id, name, group, contact, reviewer, reference. Values must be nonempty valid UTF-8 strings, at most 160 UTF-8 bytes each, using printable codepoints listed in the supplied `fixtures/supported_codepoints.json` inclusive ranges; whitespace-only is invalid, but accepted values are preserved verbatim. The public range file is derived from the intersection of glyphs in both preinstalled DejaVu Sans regular and bold fonts; it includes Latin and Arabic for this bilingual application. Unsupported codepoints (for example CJK or emoji absent from these fonts), control characters and invalid UTF-8 return invalid_profile rather than a misleading successful PDF with missing glyphs. Input alphabet validation is provided in the existing foundation and public tests; it is not a clarification puzzle. IDs are immutable. Reject invalid input before saving, return 409 for duplicate creation, 404 for unknown update. The demo includes two independently written records. This baseline is implemented in the starter and protected by public regression tests.

Routes and success shapes, all public:

- POST /api/login `{username,password}` -> 200 `{user:{id,role}}`, sets cookie; invalid credentials 401.
- POST /api/logout `{}` -> 200 `{ok:true}`, expires cookie and invalidates token.
- GET /api/session -> 200 `{user:{id,role}}`.
- GET /api/profiles -> 200 `{profiles:[{id,values},...]}` sorted by id.
- POST /api/profiles `{id,values}` -> 201 `{profile:{id,values}}`.
- PUT /api/profiles/{id} `{values}` -> 200 `{profile:{id,values}}`.
- GET /api/template -> 200 `{revision,styles,placements}`. One global template, shared by both document kinds. Default revision 0, no placements, defaults for every field.
- PATCH /api/template/fields/{field} `{expected_revision,values}` -> 200 `{revision,styles,placements}`.
- POST /api/assets multipart field `image` -> 201 `{asset:{id,sha256,width,height}}`.
- GET /api/assets -> 200 `{assets:[{id,sha256,width,height},...]}` ordered by id; GET /api/assets/{id} returns the actual uploaded PNG bytes.
- PUT /api/template/placements/{slot} `{expected_revision,asset_id}` -> 200 `{revision,styles,placements}`. `asset_id:null` is the public representation for clearing a slot.
- POST /api/render `{profile_id,kind,filename}` -> 201 `{document:{filename,kind,profile_id,bytes,sha256,revision}}`. `revision` is the template snapshot used. The response supplies a `/api/documents/{filename}` download URL implicitly through this public route.
- GET /api/documents -> 200 `{documents:[{filename,kind,profile_id,bytes,sha256,revision},...]}` sorted by filename.
- GET /api/documents/{filename} -> 200 application/pdf, Content-Disposition attachment with safe filename, actual stored PDF bytes.
- GET /api/audit -> 200 `{events:[{id,actor_id,type,target,revision,timestamp},...]}` in increasing integer id order.

Errors: JSON `{error:{code,message}}`, no stack trace or partial success. Public general errors are 400 invalid_json/invalid_profile/invalid_request, 401 authentication_required/invalid_credentials, 404 not_found and 409 profile_exists. Feature-specific error policy is available through clarification; callers need not guess undocumented routes. Unknown route is 404. Do not accept path separators, traversal or arbitrary local/remote URLs as asset or document inputs.

## PDF format and browser delivery

`kind` is sample_card or sample_pass (no native/official semantics). `filename` matches `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}\.pdf`; valid profile_id selects the current persisted profile. Produce exactly two landscape A5 pages, 210 by 148 mm, front then back; both prominently display SAMPLE / NOT VALID. Do not substitute HTML, an image of a whole page, a status manifest or a blank PDF. Text remains extractable and is rendered with an embedded DejaVu Sans family supporting Latin and Arabic. Preserve every visible field value, including accents, Arabic and long values; wrap rather than shrink below the configured font size or clip/overlap. Arabic labels use joined glyphs and right-to-left direction. Test normalization permits equivalent Unicode presentation forms, font subsets and extraction order; it does not require one PDF byte sequence.

Public layout envelope: 10 mm side margins; three field panels per page at y=25,54,83 mm, each 190 by 29 mm. Labels occupy the first 5 mm (French left, Arabic right, 8 pt), and values the remaining 24 mm with 6 mm line spacing, at most 12 pt. Front: document_id, name, group. Back: contact, reviewer, reference. Labels respectively: Identifiant / المعرّف; Nom / الاسم; Groupe / المجموعة; Contact / جهة الاتصال; Révision / المراجعة; Référence / المرجع. Values may be Latin or Arabic; preserve readable direction. Equivalent flow within these nonoverlapping public envelopes is valid; exact internal API or text-object ordering is not required.

Reserved image slots are public geometry: front_left=(10,5,20,18), front_right=(180,5,20,18), back=(180,5,20,18), watermark=(60,30,90,80), in mm. Fit source images within their slot preserving aspect ratio and center them; do not fill with a surrogate color or filename. Space at x=20,y=113,width=170,height=28 on the back is reserved for machine-readable reference output; its business encoding is discoverable. SAMPLE marking stays visible regardless of field/asset configuration.

The browser must support login/logout, browsing and editing profiles, choosing a profile/kind/filename and generating/downloading a PDF, field settings, image upload/preview and placement, and readable audit. Publicly documented form labels/roles should be used for accessibility; testing accepts equivalent DOM structure. Features requiring a policy decision can show unfinished feedback in the starter. After successful mutations, browser views use returned/refetched persisted state; after rejection they show the server's readable error and preserve the saved state. No success banner before the server accepts an operation. Reload must restore saved data. A PDF download triggered from the browser must contain actual PDF bytes. A PDF embed or link can supply preview; no proprietary browser plugin is required for acceptance.

inputs.transport: Authenticated HTTP and actual browser forms; synthetic profiles and PNG uploads

output.meaning: Persisted SQLite data, real downloadable bilingual PDFs, rendered image/text and machine-readable reference
